title: RuntimeError on visit_erased_type when using sorted(..., key=lambda...)
body:
Running mypy --py2 on this code:

```
def func():
    # type: () -> List[float]
    source = [5, 7, 2, -3, -2.6, 4.8, 6, 6.0]
    weird_sort = sorted(
        source,
        # By absolute value, ints first though.
        key=lambda a: (abs(a), 0 if isinstance(a, int) else 1)
    )
    return weird_sort

print func()
```
